$comment: Phase 2B (plan Task 25): the sales chain from quote to receipt. Every write ends in a confirmation card that lists what the other modules will do (Inventario, Costo de ventas, Facturación DIAN, Contabilidad: asiento en Ventas / Recibos de caja, Nota crédito DIAN); nothing runs before the accept (rule 17). A customer or product that is not invoice_ready gets no card: the tool answers the readiness refusal with its reasons and the assistant explains them (sales-tools.integration.test.ts). The step-up processes (invoicing.invoice.void, payments.payment.void, inventory.adjustment.post) get a card that asks for the code.
